description: Machine-readable palette/tokens for the LLM Prefill & Decode Speed Visualizer (#924). Chart fills and UI colors reference these values via CSS custom properties defined in src/index.css (:root). Values are hex where the token is opaque; rgba() tokens are omitted.
ogCardNote: /api/og share cards currently bake a separate legacy navy/sky palette that does NOT match these tokens; the mapping between card pixels and page pixels is undefined until og.js is aligned.
